name: get_content
title: Get item content
description: Read the body of one entry. mode=passages returns the passages best matching an optional query (query required for documents in this mode); mode=fulltext returns the text with offset pagination. For notes, returns the note body.

id.description: Global ID of an item, attachment, or note.

query.description: Required when mode=passages on a document: passages are ranked against it.

offset.description: Character offset when mode=fulltext. Use nextOffset from the previous call to page through.
